alerts.headline: Flood Watch issued April 14 at 5:12AM EDT until April 16 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Albany NY
alerts.desc:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall and snowmelt is possible.

* WHERE...Portions of southern Vermont, including Windham County.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers, creeks and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
alerts.instr: You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible Flood Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be prepared to take action should flooding develop.

alerts.desc:
* WHAT...West winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 40 mph expected.

* WHERE...Windham County.
alerts.instr: Winds this strong can blow around unsecured objects. Boats on open water should secure moorings.
